question.prompt: The lines satisfy \(l_1\parallel l_2\parallel l_3\). Line \(a\) intersects \(l_1\), \(l_2\), and \(l_3\) at \(A\), \(B\), and \(C\), respectively. Line \(b\) intersects \(l_1\), \(l_2\), and \(l_3\) at \(D\), \(E\), and \(F\), respectively. If \(AB=3\), \(BC=6\), and \(DE=4\), find \(EF\).

solutions.explanation: When three parallel lines intersect two lines, the corresponding segments are proportional: \(AB/BC=DE/EF\), or \(3/6=4/EF\). Therefore, \(EF=8\).
solutions.title: Use corresponding intercepts
